blocking_findings.defect: The child receives fork return0 and assigns child_pid=0 before resetting inherited SIGALRM/SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers. A child-delivered SIGTERM/SIGINT in this interval enters interrupted/stop. Because0 is non-None, stop calls held_child_signal(0); getsid(0)/getpgid(0) describe the current inherited session/group and fallback os.kill(0,SIGKILL) signals every process in that inherited group. The supervisor and unrelated group members can be killed, violating restricted ownership signaling.
blocking_findings.required_closure: Separate sealed successor: enforce positive direct-child PIDs at every signal helper and ensure the inherited handler in the fork child exits safely without invoking parent cleanup, or block/reset signals safely acrossfork. Preserve original packets and stop/failure semantics.
blocking_findings.title: Inherited child signal handler can invoke a process-group-wide PID-zero kill
